settings.heading: Full Ingredients list
settings.content:
Cyclopentasiloxane & Dimethiconol, Cyclohexasiloxane & Cyclopentasiloxane, Capric/Caprylic Triglyceride, Tocopherol, Carthamus tinctorius Seed Oil, Avena sativa Kernel Oil, Argania spinosa Kernel Oil, Prunus armeniaca Kernel Oil, Vitis vinifera Seed Oil, Parfum.

  • Safflower oil – high in linoleic acid, which nourishes scalp and hair follicles (Skolnik, 1977)
  • Argan oil – shown to protect hair like a barrier from free radical damage (Shafiri, 2023)
  • Apricot seed oil – a natural source of sterols and squalene that support delicate skin’s natural oil production (Rudzinska, 2017)
  • Grape seed oil – antioxidant, antibacterial, helps reduce irritation (Khanna, 2002) and very good at restoring hair smoothness (Demir, 2023)
  • Tocopherols – natural plant forms of vitamin E that protect against free-radical damage, which occurs in dry or inflamed skin (Michalak, 2022)

The composition of our products may be updated periodically. For the most current ingredient information, we advise checking the ingredient list on the product packaging that you receive, which will always reflect the latest updates.
